summary: Diagnose where HPWL changes across global input, legalize, improve placement, and final mirror stages before assigning routes.
use_when: Every Teacher round before selecting routes, especially when legal HPWL and final HPWL disagree.
avoid_when: Never use as the only mechanism; it is evidence selection only.
done_criteria: Teacher names the dominant HPWL-loss stage
Teacher separates final donors from stage donors
Teacher states one falsifiable route outcome

summary: Use the prepared evolved_legalm start branch for dense high-utilization standard-cell cases where legalization HPWL inflation dominates.
use_when: Dense/high-util cases show large legalization HPWL inflation or prior evidence says LEGALM/global frontier is stage-strong.
avoid_when: Do not force it when macro/row fragmentation or conflict repair dominates and metrics favor Diamond or negotiation.
done_criteria: Student switches to or continues the intended LEGALM seed
legalization-stage HPWL inflation is reduced or failure is attributed to handoff/consumer
source diff changes LEGALM or its handoff instead of only constants

summary: Use evolved_diamond or Diamond-family starts for local greedy legalization/detail improvement when local closure is the likely source.
use_when: Baseline Diamond is strong, row conflicts are local, or LEGALM/negotiation adds runtime without stage benefit.
avoid_when: Do not copy classic Diamond as a no-op; add a new objective, candidate generator, or handoff consumer.
done_criteria: Student names the local HPWL source
diff changes local scoring/search or legalizer/improve handoff
result is compared against all canonical baselines

summary: Use evolved_negotiation when conflict resolution, row scarcity, or cut-row-like feasibility pressure dominates legalization.
use_when: Diamond fails or produces large displacement/legality stress while negotiation succeeds or conflict counters explain the gap.
avoid_when: Do not let negotiation dominate so strongly that legalizer/DPO changes become no-ops; require stage counters and source mutation.
done_criteria: Conflict mechanism counters are nonzero
legal placement is produced under stress
Student either improves negotiation internals or builds a handoff consumer

summary: Implement LEGALM/global differential guidance plus detailed refinement as a source-level frontier that can beat pure local greedy when the handoff is correct.
use_when: Legalization stage inflates HPWL, local greedy cannot see global net movement, or a global route has stage signal but loses final HPWL through handoff/improve consumption.
avoid_when: Do not approximate with a disconnected greedy interval polish that discards the global guidance signal; do not abandon a stage-strong global route before repairing detailed refinement/handoff.
done_criteria: Legalization uses global/differential score before commit
refined legal solution stays connected to guidance output
handoff state exposes residual or frontier information to improve placement
Teacher preserves at least one global-plus-detailed-repair route when global legal-stage evidence exists and final HPWL is weak

summary: Use local greedy legalizer improvements as a bounded repair or second-stage hybrid after global or negotiation guidance.
use_when: A global/negotiation route has useful stage signal but leaves local HPWL or displacement defects.
avoid_when: Do not rerun unchanged Diamond endpoints or call repeated random tails; distill the local clue into one bounded source mechanism.
done_criteria: Hybrid sequence is inside the algorithm, not repeated endpoint execution
local repair consumes residual/frontier state
runtime is bounded by candidate caps or caches

summary: Recommended runtime-quality DPO donor using source-edge cached scoring and bounded candidate evaluation.
use_when: Final HPWL needs improve-placement recovery but runtime must stay controlled; use as first DPO donor or mutation base.
avoid_when: Do not treat it as a finished universal optimum; inspect stage metrics and mutate candidate generation/objective if final HPWL plateaus.
done_criteria: DPO donor or mutation runs with nonzero counters
after-improve HPWL improves or failure is attributed to acceptance/objective
runtime stays explainable through cache/cap evidence

summary: Quality-ceiling DPO donor for stronger final HPWL exploration when extra bounded runtime is acceptable.
use_when: A candidate needs a more aggressive improve-placement consumer and prior runtime headroom exists.
avoid_when: Do not promote if it buys quality only by broad rescans or repeated endpoint execution; rewrite for cache/parallelism first.
done_criteria: Quality mechanism changes source-level candidate/objective/acceptance
runtime cost is classified as useful bounded search or fixable implementation cost
Teacher receives enough evidence to choose quality vs runtime frontier

summary: Pass residual high-impact net/cell/row information from legalization into improve placement so DPO preserves or exploits legal-stage gains.
use_when: Legal HPWL improves but after-improve or final HPWL erases the gain; stage donor needs a consumer repair.
avoid_when: Do not add metadata that no later stage consumes; require nonzero producer and consumer counters.
done_criteria: Legalization writes bounded handoff state
improve placement consumes it in candidate ordering/scoring/acceptance
logs prove both producer and consumer ran

summary: Add and inspect lightweight counters/logs to separate algorithm failure, non-execution, stale binary, and runtime bottlenecks.
use_when: Every route with a new mechanism, especially when metrics are weak, runtime changes, or counters may be zero.
avoid_when: Do not log per candidate/per net in hot loops; aggregate stage-local counters only.
done_criteria: Counters prove primary mechanism liveness
runtime bottleneck is classified
zero-counter or stale-binary paths are reported as non-executed
